purpose: Messages sent while a response is generating, waiting above the prompt input (TanStack AI `useChat` `queue`): each shows its text in send order with a button that removes it before it is sent; changes are announced politely.
useWhen: A chat that lets the reader keep typing while a response streams and holds the extra messages.
Directly above the `prompt-input`, in the composer area of the conversation.
avoidWhen: Prompts the reader may choose to send → `suggestion-group`.
related: `suggestion-group` — prompts to send, not prompts waiting.
bestPractices: Keep it mounted for the whole chat, so every change is announced.
Keep each queued message's id, so a removal cancels the right one.
When the queue empties, move focus back to the prompt input.
